## Outcome
Done. `src/checkout.ts` now throws `out of stock <sku>` when a reservation fails, instead of silently skipping it. Both tests in `test/checkout.test.ts` pass.

- None for this file. The throw happens partway through the loop, so earlier SKUs in the same call stay reserved. The doc comment doesn't say whether reservations should roll back, and the tests don't cover that case. I left it alone since it's outside the brief.

Done. `src/checkout.ts` now throws `out of stock <sku>` when a reservation fails, instead of silently skipping it. Both tests in `test/checkout.test.ts` pass.

## Changes
- `src/checkout.ts`: in the reservation loop, `if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { continue; }` became `if (!reserve(sku, qty)) { throw new Error(\`out of stock ${sku}\`); }`. Nothing else in the file changed.

## Verification
- `checkout throws when out of stock` (B2 has no stock, expects `/out of stock B2/`): met. `node --test test/checkout.test.ts` reported it passing.
- `checkout returns the total` (C3 for 1000 cents, expects 1080): met. Same run, passing.
- The file's test run reported 2 pass, 0 fail.
- I ran the test file directly with `node --test` because the Volt `tests` tool did not find `test/checkout.test.ts`.

## Open issues
- None for this file. The throw happens partway through the loop, so earlier SKUs in the same call stay reserved. The doc comment doesn't say whether reservations should roll back, and the tests don't cover that case. I left it alone since it's outside the brief.
